title: Animation From Video (codename: Annie's Tractor) open to public.
author: Sacred_B
selftext: Well I expected a couple people to say "that's neat" but apparently it's something y'all want so here it is. [https://github.com/surfhorse/Annies\_Tractor](https://github.com/surfhorse/Annies_Tractor) . Two branches main with everything for you to keep vibing with, and freelease if you just want to use the tool. There is a HOLD\_MY\_HAND.md that an agent should be able to use to get everything setup and work you through your first project.

comments.author: MesquiteBarbecueChip
comments.body: it needs ground plane footlocking, the boxers are sliding all over the place, also maybe use IK physics/collision, there's some weird stuff going on when they start rotating, otherwise it looks cool, keep goin

replies.author: Sacred_B
replies.body: Luckily, I don't need that level of accuracy for my use case. It's there for people to refine on their own. A lot of sliding on this one comes from the legs just not being in the shot The clip on my first post is more planted.
